summary: Frontend-only verification of DoctorWorkspace P2+P3 (NOW/PROPOSALS/FORENSICS sub-tabs, chain/book FilterBar, Explain component with lazy long body, density pass on CollapsibleSection headers). All 9 test cases from the review request PASS. No console errors, no React duplicate-key warnings, no regressions on LIVE cockpit or doctor-strip navigation.

detailed_results.1_doctor_workspace_and_tabs: PASS — doctor-workspace + doctor-tab-{now,proposals,forensics} + all 5 book filter chips + sol/rh/all render; default sub-tab NOW visible.
detailed_results.2_now_content: PASS — tempo-gauge (tempo-sol, tempo-rh), autopilot-card with autopilot-chains rows (sol, rh), autopilot-books, desk-allocator, autopilot-canary, trail-stop-card, helius-budget-card all present. autopilot-technique / learning-panel / applied-history-card correctly ABSENT on NOW.
detailed_results.3_explain_component: PASS — for doctor-explain-now, autopilot-explain, immutable-rails: short text + toggle always present, long body absent before click, present after clicking 'more', absent again after clicking 'less' (verified DOM mount/unmount).
detailed_results.4_filter_rh_and_hunt: PASS — filter-rh removes autopilot-chain-sol + tempo-sol, book chips reduce to rh_pons only. filter-all restores both. filter-hunt auto-activates SOL chain and allocator rows reduce to allocator-row-hunt (allocator-row-scalp absent). Filter persists across reload via localStorage ui.doctor.filter.
detailed_results.5_proposals_tab: PASS — strategy-doctor + doctor-auto-apply-toggle + doctor-run-now + applied-history-card present (not clicked). tempo-gauge and learning-panel correctly ABSENT.
detailed_results.6_forensics_tab: PASS — autopilot-technique (header reads 'TECHNIQUE LAB · WHAT EACH BOOK'S OWN FILLS SAY (7D)'), learning-panel, Trading Costs card all present. autopilot-chains + autopilot-canary correctly ABSENT. Under filter-hunt only technique-hunt and technique-regime-hunt rows remain.
detailed_results.7_subtab_persistence: PASS — after selecting FORENSICS and reloading, localStorage.ui.doctor.tab='forensics' and doctor-forensics is the mounted panel (doctor-now count=0).
detailed_results.8_density_leak_check: PASS — collapsed CollapsibleSection headers render title (+ optional badge) only; description text is on the button's title attribute, not inline. Verified on section-reentry (LIVE), section-scanner + section-greylist (SCAN), section-scorecard + section-classifier + section-pl-by-source (BOOKS), section-bot-control (CONTROL).
detailed_results.9_regression: PASS — LIVE cockpit renders kpi-strip, cockpit-grid, doctor-strip, skip-ticker. doctor-strip-open lands on the DOCTOR view (doctor-workspace visible). No console errors (only benign 401 for one WS/resource + WS retry warning, unrelated to feature). No React duplicate-key warnings while cycling through all three doctor sub-tabs.

critical_code_review_comments: DoctorWorkspace.jsx line 62: the long Explain body for doctor-explain-now is fine now that mount is lazy, but the very long inline string keeps the JSX file readable-limit — consider extracting to a copy constant.

doctorFilter.js matchesFilter treats untagged items as visible under any filter — intentional but worth documenting; ensure book-tagged suggestions always populate metrics.book to avoid bleed-through when RH filter is active.
